description: Stage gate used by the Supervisor between worker hand-offs. Records a PASS/FAIL decision against an explicit list of gate criteria for the stage just completed, and returns the next action (advance | retry | escalate).
checklist: 1. Identify the stage being gated (scaffold|generate|validate|test|review|curate|learn) and load its gate criteria from the scope's `.ai/instruct.md` plus governance_refs
2. Score the worker's output against each criterion; record pass/fail with a one-line reason
3. If all criteria pass → emit { decision: 'advance', next_stage }
4. If any criterion fails on first attempt → emit { decision: 'retry', failures, guidance }; the Supervisor re-delegates with the failure list
5. If retry fails (second attempt for the same stage) → emit { decision: 'escalate' }; Supervisor stops and asks the user
6. Call `log-action` with the gate decision and stage
